title: Under Paris's Notre Dame, archaeologists are unearthing 2,000 years of history
summary: Since Notre Dame Cathedral reopened to the public in 2024 following a devastating fire, it has been one of the most popular tourist destinations in Paris. What many don’t realize is that the work continues near the cathedral underground.
